package.name: pinkrab_mujoco
package.description:
The rig in MuJoCo: scene.xml loaded, stepped headless, asked about contact, and the reach it implies - the robot as the engine has it, with nothing about how it is drawn or who is driving it.
Both the studio and the safety gate answer questions about geometry, and they have to answer them the same way: what stops the arm on the page is what stops it on the bench only if both read the one scene.xml. So the scene lives here, beside neither of them, and each is a client.
Not in pinkrab_core, which the cli and the umi tools import: someone calibrating an arm should not be made to install MuJoCo to do it.
The simulation that makes takes and evaluates policies is pinkrab_sim, which builds on this. Nothing here depends on it: the gate imports this package on the robot's host and must not take in a policy's training stack with it.
